svg.title: Kizuna flow: offline-first sync for Supabase. Writes land in local SQLite, reconcile after reconnect, and your Postgres remains the source of truth.
svg.desc: Offline-first sync for Supabase. Three device cards share one sync loop. Noah's laptop and David's tablet are tagged online and in sync. Sarah's phone is offline: her card is dashed, her wire is dimmed, and the writes she makes land in local SQLite and queue as small slips inside her card. When she reconnects, her queued write rides the wire as a payload chip through the kizunasync card into your own Supabase project and reconciles there, and a chip stamped applied travels back to her. Only after that verdict does the update fan out from Supabase through kizunasync to Noah and David, who each get a check mark. Then Sarah goes offline again and the loop repeats. Your Postgres remains the source of truth throughout.
svg.text: Writes land in local SQLite and reconcile after reconnect: your Postgres remains the source of truth.
